posts.title: Four Aircraft on the Runway: Incursion at JFK
posts.description: On the 17th of April an Airbus A330-343 operated by Swiss International Air Lines abandoned their take-off when they saw the runway in front of them was full of planes. OK, a bit of hyperbole there: there were three on the runway and one about to enter. Let’s back up. It was a clear day…

posts.title: Early Evidence in the Palm Beach Learjet 60 Crash
posts.description: On the 1st of November 2026 shortly before 13:00 local time, a Learjet 60 crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida. This has received mainstream media attention primarily because of the disturbing audio and unexpected violence of the crash, which has left a deep crater.
